title: Hop limit not validated against MAX_HOP_LIMIT on parse
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs:319-337 (RREQ), 383-401 (RREP)

MAX_HOP_LIMIT=15 is defined (line 21) but from_bytes accepts any hop_limit/hop_count value 0-255. EXPANDING_RING has max 15, but an attacker can send RREQ with hop_limit=255 or RREP with hop_count=255.

Failure scenario: Attacker sends RREP with hop_count=255. If hop_count is used in routing metric comparisons, this could defeat best-path selection or trigger overflow in downstream computations.

Fix: Add validation in from_bytes: reject or clamp values > MAX_HOP_LIMIT. Return LoadngError::InvalidHopLimit(u8) for values > 15.
